- Palm sugar (or brown sugar) — 1 tsp to balance heat and salt.

- Thai basil (or holy basil) — handful stirred in at the end for fragrance.

- Galangal or lemongrass (sliced) — aromatic complexity if you have them.  
- Toasted coconut cream (browning a bit of the coconut milk first) — adds richness and depth.  
- A pinch of ground turmeric or a dash of tamarind paste — for earthiness/tang (optional).  

Typical amounts to start with (adjust to taste): 1 tbsp nam prik pao or extra curry paste, 1–2 tsp fish sauce, 1 tsp palm sugar, juice of 1/2 lime, 3–4 torn kaffir leaves, handful Thai basil. Add chilies slowly, taste as you go.
